0022600113.text: The Pacers (1-0, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) visit the Nets (0-1, 4th in the Atlantic and 10th in the East), who are 1.5 games back in their division. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Brooklyn is missing Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pacers won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
